ops.oldText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
ops.newText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement or elect not to renew any renewal term for any reason following the Initial Term upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other Party.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have shortened the post-Initial Term notice period from 90 to 30 days and confirmed it covers non-renewal, since our playbook requires auto-renewing terms to be exitable on 30 days' notice (60 days at the outside). We are happy to land at 60 days if that is easier for you.
input.summary: Reduce non-renewal/termination notice window after Initial Term from 90 days to 30 days.
